cohort.routing_basis: validated final active branch inherited from Level 1

method.primary: K-means on five equally z-standardized Level 1 dimension scores
method.selection_rule: Selected k=3 from the eligible 3–5 profile candidates using the lowest equal-weight mean rank across separation, compactness, bootstrap stability, and K-medoids agreement.

profile_names.1: Profile 1: lower agency and study engagement and lower career-transition readiness
profile_names.2: Profile 2: lower human-capital trajectory and higher agency and study engagement
profile_names.3: Profile 3: higher human-capital trajectory and higher economic resources

quality.status: Provisional solution — interpret with the failed diagnostics clearly reported
quality.agency_score_caution: Level 1 agency alpha was approximately 0.551 and remains a substantive interpretation caveat.
quality.crosswalk_caution: Study-to-career alignment relies on the documented Level 1 crosswalk and requires expert review.
